data.name: Mason Dixon Saloon
data.tagline: Good Food. Cold Drinks. Great Times.
data.about: If you're a meat connoisseur, you know the difference an in-house smoker can make. You won't be disappointed when you visit Mason Dixon Saloon for delicious smoked meats. We smoke our pork baby back ribs and slow cook the meat for our Reubens. We even have a special dry rub for wings, burgers, pork baby back ribs, pork loins and beef loins.

items.name: Dixon Dice
items.desc: Pepperjack cheese curds. A customer favorite!

items.name: Loaded Nachos
items.desc: Choose chicken, steak or beef. BBQ pulled pork when available

items.name: Kickin' Chicken Wings
items.desc: 10 jumbo wings served naked with our Mason Dixon seasoning rub. Want them tossed in a sauce? Just ask!

items.name: Half Rack
items.desc: Baby back ribs with our secret dry rub and your choice of 2 sides. Thursday and Sunday from 4:30pm

items.name: Full Rack
items.desc: Baby back ribs with our secret dry rub and your choice of 2 sides. Thursday and Sunday from 4:30pm

items.name: Mason Burger
items.desc: Our juicy 1/2 lb. burger with Applewood bacon and Pepperjack cheese on a toasted bun

items.name: Western Burger
items.desc: Angus patty topped with bacon, onion ring, BBQ sauce, jalapeno and Pepperjack cheese

items.name: Patty Melt
items.desc: Angus patty between sauteed onions, Swiss and American cheese on marble rye

items.name: Angus Burger
items.desc: Our 1/2 lb. patty served your way with American, Pepperjack or Swiss

items.name: Pulled Pork
items.desc: 8oz of our rib meat pulled off the bone. Pair it with our Linda Mae BBQ sauce!

items.name: Cod Planks
items.desc: Two seasoned battered cod planks with your choice of 2 sides

items.name: Dixon Chicken
items.desc: Seasoned 6oz. grilled chicken breast topped with two strips of bacon and Swiss. Ask for Linda Mae BBQ sauce on the side!

items.name: Reuben
items.desc: Slow-roasted corned beef brisket, sauerkraut, Swiss and Thousand Island on marble rye or Texas toast

items.name: Ribeye Steak
items.desc: 6oz. choice ribeye grilled to order with mushrooms, roasted peppers, onions and Pepperjack on Texas toast

items.name: Cuban
items.desc: Our famous pulled pork piled high with honey ham, dill pickles, mustard and American cheese on marble rye

items.name: B.L.T.
items.desc: 4 slices of Applewood bacon, tomato and lettuce on toasted Texas toast

items.name: Grilled Cheese
items.desc: Classic grilled cheese on Texas toast. Add jalapenos, tomato or bacon for $1.50

specials.title: Rib Night
specials.detail: Baby back ribs smoked in-house with our secret dry rub. Half rack $24, full rack $30.

specials.title: Private Parties
specials.detail: Rent our lower level for up to 99 guests, with your own bar, bartender and media center. Catering available.

reviews.text: Stopped here on my way to Wyoming, best ribs I've ever had, literally falling off the bone, wonderful flavor, and super friendly staff
reviews.name: Thomas C.

reviews.text: Food was wonderful! Ribs, pulled pork, beef brisket, and 5 bean salad on the sampler was amazing!! My wife had the pulled pork quesadilla and cheese fries. Did NOT disappoint, we will be back!
reviews.name: Seth W.

reviews.text: The ribs are amazing. Great atmosphere and staff.
reviews.name: Kurt D

reviews.text: Fantastic wings. Great service. Pleasurable experience. Will return.
reviews.name: Jason D.

reviews.text: Awesome Atmosphere, great bartenders and staff. Music selection is perfect blend. Drinks made just right.
reviews.name: Nate H.

reviews.text: Excellent food. Very clean establishment Friendly, efficient staff! Highly recommend
reviews.name: Sherri H.

reviews.text: I met the owner Joe tonight. What a great guy! The design of this bar is definitely worth checking out! Then stick around for the great bartenders, friendly people and awesome music!
reviews.name: Robert B.

reviews.text: Always great staff excellent food and icy cold beverages
reviews.name: John K.
